name: Neon Lotus Metropolis
description: A futuristic city built on giant bioluminescent lotus pads, neon veins pulsing through canals of light.
prompt: Cyberpunk metropolis at night, built atop enormous glowing lotus pads floating on a dark reflective water surface. Neon circuitry traces the stems and petals in electric blues, pinks, and purples. Hovering vehicles glide between towers shaped like blooming flowers. Ultra-detailed, high contrast, reflective surfaces, cinematic composition.
caption: Where technology blossoms 🌸💡 #NeonLotus
